title: Travel & Accommodations

hotels.title: La Quinta Resort and Club
hotels.description: A historic desert sanctuary featuring multiple pools, beautiful gardens, and world-class tennis courts.

hotels.title: Tommy Bahama Miramonte
hotels.description: A chic, relaxing desert retreat in Indian Wells surrounded by olive trees and mountain views.

hotels.title: Grand Hyatt Indian Wells
hotels.description: Sprawling luxury resort with golf courses, massive pools, and mountain vistas.

hotels.title: Renaissance Esmeralda
hotels.description: A relaxing and comfortable foothills resort featuring spacious grounds and a sand-beach pool.

hotels.title: JW Marriott Desert Springs
hotels.description: A sprawling lakeside oasis featuring scenic boat rides, championship golf, and resident pink flamingos.

hotels.title: Airbnb & Vacation Rentals
hotels.description: Private desert homes and villas in Indio, La Quinta, or Palm Desert—perfect for groups.

airports.title: Palm Springs (PSP)
airports.description: The closest airport, only a 30-minute drive to Indio, though it offers fewer direct flight options.

airports.title: Ontario (ONT)
airports.description: A highly convenient and stress-free option, situated about a 1.5-hour drive from Indio.

airports.title: Los Angeles (LAX)
airports.description: Offers the most flight options and carriers, but requires a 2.5-hour drive depending on traffic.

favorites.title: Joshua Tree National Park
favorites.description: A breathtaking national park filled with Mojave wilderness, famous rock formations, and desert trails.

favorites.title: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway
favorites.description: Ride the world's largest rotating tram car up the cliffs of Chino Canyon for panoramic views.

favorites.title: Desert Hiking
favorites.description: Explore scenic trails like Indian Canyons, Bump and Grind, or Tahquitz Canyon.

favorites.title: Championship Golf
favorites.description: Tee off at PGA West or other world-renowned public courses in La Quinta and Indian Wells.
